Dear Sir/Madam,

Despite regular usage and proper maintenance, the room temperature remains
unchanged, which is causing significant inconvenience. The product was
purchased recently and is still under warranty.

suitable resolution at the earliest.

Looking forward to your prompt response.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Shubham Sahu
